entities.summary: Marco Antonio Hernández is a Dominican professional baseball infielder for the Olmecas de Tabasco of the Mexican League. Listed at 6 feet 0 inches (1.83 m) and 200 pounds (91 kg), he bats left-handed and throws right-handed. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Boston Red Sox.
